heroHeadline: EU Races to Ratify US Trade Deal by July 4 — Ukraine Cluster 1 Vote Set June 16
heroSubtitle: EU ambassadors formally endorsed the EU-US trade deal on May 27; the EP INTA committee votes June 2 and the full plenary ratifies June 15-18 ahead of Trump's July 4 deadline. Ukraine's first EU accession cluster (Fundamentals) vote is confirmed for the June 16 General Affairs Council — with all six clusters targeted for June under Cyprus Presidency. The EU fined Temu €200 million under the Digital Services Act (second-ever DSA fine) and approved a €2.8 billion Ukraine Facility disbursement. The EU-Western Balkans Summit in Tivat, Montenegro is set for June 5. The ECB is fully expected to hike rates 25bp on June 11 as eurozone inflation holds at 3.0%.
footerNote: Data sourced from official EU institutions (EUR-Lex, European Commission, ECB, Eurostat, European Council), major outlets, and institutional analyses.
